{{color2|fff|Generation IV}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Underground Man/Quotes}} ==In animation== The Underground Man appeared in the {{aniseries|DP}} episode ''[[DP037|The Grass Menagerie!]]'' while [[Team Rocket]] was exploring the [[Underground]]. He convinced Jessie, James, and Meowth to dig up [[sphere]]s and [[shard]]s for him from the Underground, and fed them as a way of thanks. However, while they ate, he fled with the treasures. ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{ground color}}|bordercolor={{ground color dark}} |ja=石塚運昇 ''[[Unshō Ishizuka]]'' |en=[[Eric Schussler]] |es_la=Enrique Cervantes |es_eu=Antonio Esquivas |cs=Michal Holán |fi=Pasi Ruohonen |pt_br=Fábio Vilalonga |pl=Marek Robaczewski }} ==In the manga== [[File:Underground Man Adventures.png|thumb|200px|The Underground Man in Pokémon Adventures]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== The Underground Man was first mentioned in ''[[PS342|A Conk on Cranidos's Cranium]]'', spending time with [[Roark]] in the [[Underground]]. He makes his first appearance in ''[[PS411|Double Trouble with Dialga and Palkia I]]'', where he and [[Byron]] were digging underground with the [[Explorer Kit]] to avoid Team Galactic from tracking the Sinnoh Gym Leaders. In the [[PS412|next chapter]], he suffered the effects from the distortion of time and space caused by {{p|Dialga}} and {{p|Palkia}} battling. In ''[[PS416|Double Trouble with Dialga and Palkia VI]]'', the Underground Man along with Byron, [[Professor Rowan]], and [[Mr. Berlitz|Sir Berlitz]] reappear at the [[Spear Pillar]] and attempt to stop [[Charon]] from escaping. ====Pokémon==== {{TrainerPoké |width=80 |trainer=Underground Man |pkmn=Dugtrio (×3) |type1=Ground |img=Underground Man Dugtrio Adventures.png |cap=Underground Man's Dugtrio |epnum=PS411 |epname=Double Trouble with Dialga and Palkia I |desc=The Underground Man uses these three {{p|Dugtrio}} to help him dig underground.
